title: fix(metadata-protocol,cli): os migrate packageless-overlays lists a package-less view container cannot_declare, and --apply never attempts it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgVTHCxahQmaNucVGiWhnJ8X)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os migrate packageless-overlays` 的预览遇到无包的视图容器行（`list` / `listViews` / `form` / `formViews` 写在一起的那种），不再列成"可移动"，而是列成 `cannot_declare` 并给出出路（把每个视图逐个存进配对包，再删掉容器行）；`--apply` 不再尝试它，也不再每次报失败。
- 为什么改：容器的 schema 没有 `overrides` 键，迁移第二步的声明式保存必被拒，预览却说可移动，`--apply` 每次失败、行原样不动，运维无从下手；另外 main 上两处关门（无包写、写名指只读基包）把容器的写也关了，403 指向一个做不到的修法，连"删掉容器行"这条出路都被拒。
- 风险与回滚：判断取自 save 门自己的 schema（不另列类型清单），实测五种叠加类型里只有视图容器装不下 `overrides`；两处关门对容器恢复为关门前的行为（无包保存、删除可用），其余类型不变。回滚即撤本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` 的 `overrideDeclarationRefusedByShape` 与 `overlayPairFixAdmits` 新增的一行；`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` 的 `classifyPackagelessRow`（新分支在 `no_pair` 之后、`foreign_declaration` 之前）；`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts` 的 `reasonOf`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts -t 30261`（需先 build metadata-protocol），预期 5 条全绿；在 main 的字节上这 5 条全红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30261

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `PackagelessOverlayDisposition` (reachable through the exported `PackagelessOverlayCensus`) gains `cannot_declare`; the package-less write close and the close of a write naming the read-only base no longer refuse a view container's write, whose named fix cannot be taken
Metadata-protocol: semantic — an author's package-less save or delete (and a save naming the read-only base, `?package=<base>`) of a view container (`list` / `listViews` / `form` / `formViews`) over a name one read-only package ships, refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` since the D11 close, succeeds again: the close names a fix (a declared save into the pair) a container cannot take. Every other shape is closed as before. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` ships `minor`; `@objectstack/cli` `patch` (seat correction at 5cbefbb3, the #30168 / PR #30322 precedent).
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` line 128 refuses the package-less write "once movable as a declared override"; a container is never movable as one, so the sentence stays true, and no skill teaches writing a container over a packaged name.

## What changes

The card's Expected: "The preview and `--apply` agree: a row listed `movable` moves, or a container row is listed with the reason it cannot move." This PR takes the second arm (the order's fork: make the preview honest, leave the container schema as it is; widening `ViewSchema` is a `packages/spec` design question, not a migration fix).

**One predicate, from the save door's own schema.** `overrideDeclarationRefusedByShape(type, body)` (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`) parses the body with an `overrides` probe through `resolveOverlaySchema`, the resolver the save door validates with, and answers `true` only when the parse names `overrides` as an unrecognized key at the body's root. In a union it must be named by every branch still diagnosing the body (the view union mutes the branches the body does not claim to a root kind mismatch, `focusClaimedBranch`), so a view body that claims no member is not answered `true`. No list of shapes is kept: a member that gains or loses the key is answered by its schema.

**Measured over the five overlay types the ceremony moves** (pinned in `protocol.override-declaration-shape.test.ts`, which also pins that its fixture covers every `allowEnvironmentOverlay` type): the view container answers `true` in all four spellings (`list`, `listViews`, `form`, `formViews`); a single view, a list overlay, a dashboard, a report, a translation and an email template each spread `OverrideDeclarationFields` and answer `false`. So the view container is the one container-shaped member with this mismatch.

**The census.** `classifyPackagelessRow` takes the canonical type and returns `cannot_declare` (with `base` and `pair`) for such a body, after `multi_shipped` / `no_pair` and before `foreign_declaration` / `shadowed`, because those two dispositions' ways out end in this ceremony moving the row. `migratePackagelessOverlays` acts on `movable` rows only, so it never attempts the row: no outcome, no failure, no pair ensured for it, and the CLI exits 0.

**The two closes.** On `main` both closes refused a container's write with `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, naming a fix (a declared save into the pair) that the container schema refuses (measured, red leg below). Both closes are built on "close only where the fix can be taken" (#28576 ruling 2; the #28905 docblock "every write this closes has a door, the pair; every other one keeps the write it has on `main`"):
- the package-less close classifies by the same `classifyPackagelessRow`, so a `cannot_declare` row's package-less save and DELETE stay open: they are the one door such a row keeps, and the way out ends with that DELETE;
- `overlayPairFixAdmits`, the "fix can be taken" predicate both closes ask, now also asks the shape (for a real body; a bare identity has no shape), so the close of a write naming the read-only base leaves a container's write as it was before that close. The row such a write stores is listed `cannot_declare`, `boundToBase`, and a delete naming the base removes it.

**CLI.** `reasonOf` prints the way out under "left as they are": save each of the container's views into the pair as a single view named `OBJECT.VIEW` (one the base ships declaring `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, a new one declaring nothing), then delete the container row with a delete naming no package (naming the base, for a row bound to it). JSON rows carry `disposition: "cannot_declare"`, `outcome: "left"`.

**Docs.** Two sentences this PR made false, amended: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the `os migrate packageless-overlays` row: "move each") and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (the D11 callout: every package-less write onto a ✅-type packaged item is refused).

**Changeset:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` + `@objectstack/cli` patch, both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `objectql` `protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[#30261]` (5 cases, real `ObjectQL` engine and registry): the census lists the active and draft container rows `cannot_declare` with base and pair, `--apply` returns no outcome and no base line, ensures no pair, and a re-run lists the same; a single view beside it still moves; the close leaves the container's package-less save, DELETE and first save open; the close of a write naming the base leaves it open and the stored row is listed `cannot_declare` `boundToBase`, removable by a delete naming the base; the way out holds end to end (the default view saved into the pair declaring the override, `showcase_task.mine` saved as the pair's own, the container deleted naming no package, then the census lists nothing and the read serves the pair's view).
- `metadata-protocol` `protocol.override-declaration-shape.test.ts` (new; no harness for this predicate existed): the measurement above, plus a container with an unknown key of its own still `true`, a body claiming no view member `false`, a schema-less type `false`.
- `cli` `packageless-overlays.integration.test.ts`, new describe over a real SQLite database: the preview lists the container `cannot_declare` / `left`; `--apply --yes` exits 0 with `failed: 0`, `moved: 0`, the rows unchanged and no pair stored.

## Acceptance notes

- The order asked whether ADR-0146 D11/D2/D10 requires container rows to move through the ceremony. D11 reads "Every `sys_metadata` row with `package_id` NULL that overlays an item a code package ships becomes a declared override of that item"; D2 defines the declaration as a key "in the item's body" and never names a container. A container is not itself an item the read serves by name (it expands to `OBJECT.VIEW` items), and the way out moves each of those items as D11 describes. Read as not requiring the container row itself to move; reported here for the seat rather than as `needs_decision`.
- `basedOn` is not judged and the probe's value is a fixed well-formed declaration: only the key's acceptance is read.

## Verification

All readings on head `3413e7bb` (the fix's four commits plus a merge of `main` at `0837fdc0`, which carries #30322's change to the same `overlayPairFixAdmits`: the shape check runs first, then `overrideWriteVerdict(…, fix.pendingPairScope)`), except the red/green legs, taken before the merge on `efbca752` / `17adf261` with `main`'s bytes at `8b117c0e`.
